1. SELECT sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value, sr.unit  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   JOIN work_orders wo ON wo.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   WHERE wo.fault_code = 'SUB' AND a.asset_id = 'SUB-002'  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC  
   LIMIT 1;

2. SELECT sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value, sr.unit  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   WHERE a.asset_id = 'SUB-002'  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC  
   LIMIT 1;

3. SELECT sr.reading_time, sr.sensor_type, sr.reading_value, sr.unit  
   FROM sensor_readings sr  
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id  
   WHERE a.asset_id = 'SUB-002'  
   ORDER BY sr.reading_time DESC  
   LIMIT 1;
